process.boundary_note: Covers energy delivered to the unit operations listed in `steps`. Not covered: reaction enthalpies of precursor decomposition, process emissions (NOx from nitrate calcination, flare CO2), solvent and water supply, wastewater treatment, equipment embodied impacts, and the electrocatalyst coating line (area-based, listed as unmodeled). Each occurrence of a step in a route is counted in full.

reference.electricity: EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub (January 2025), Table 6, US Average row: 771.5 lb CO2/MWh, 0.057 lb CH4/MWh, 0.008 lb N2O/MWh, eGRID2023; grid gross loss 4.2%. GWP100 AR5 (CH4 = 28, N2O = 265).

reference.thermo: Fuel-to-product thermal efficiency of indirect calciners (0.3-0.5) and rotary/spray dryers (0.4-0.7); Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook, 9th ed., Sec. 12 (drying) and rotary-kiln practice. Screening values, replace with measured duty where available.
reference.mechanical: Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook, 9th ed.: order-of-magnitude specific energies for agitated vessels (0.1-1 kW/m3), fine grinding of soft solids (5-30 kWh/t), paste extrusion (20-60 kWh/t), vacuum filtration (1-5 kWh/t). Screening values with ranges; evidence_tier engineering_assumption.
